name: @maocili/dsh-vibe
description: DSH plugin (per-project initializer, REQUIREMENTS v1.0): materializes a versioned rule pack into each project — fresh .agents/notes skeleton, marker rule segments in root AGENTS.md, and selected skill copies under .agents/skills. Never writes the user-global plane. Content lives in packages/.

scripts.package:build: pnpm run package:check && pnpm pack --pack-destination artifacts
